title: AI fragment based optimization of saffron and chamomile phytochemicals as aryl hydrocarbon receptor inhibitors for dementia therapy an integrated computational approach.
authors: Khan, Asra; Ali, Nouman; Asrar, Beenish; Ahmad, Saara
one_liner_zh: 该研究用AI片段优化藏红花和洋甘菊植物化学物作为芳烃受体抑制剂治疗痴呆，核心是蛋白-小分子互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接和MD模拟针对AHR受体，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Dementia represents a rapidly rising global health challenge as a progressive neurodegenerative disease with few options for disease-modifyingtreatments. The present studyaimed to explore the leading phytochemicals from Crocus sativus (saffron) and Matricaria chamomilla (chamomile) and apply AI fragmentation on lead phytochemicals to target the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR), an expertized target for dementia therapy. Bioactive compounds were screened from ISO 3632-2-2010 (E) specified for saffron and GC-MS specified for chamomile. Protein Network mapping, Density Functional Theory, Molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to determine thebinding affinity and interactions stability of key phytochemicals with AHR, such as safranal and bisabolone oxide A. In-silico ADMET predictions of pharmacokinetics and toxicity showed good properties for these molecules. In addition, their structuraland pharmacological properties were optimized to enhance drug-like features by using artificial intelligence (AI) generative model. Collectively, our findings highlight these AI-enhanced phytochemicals as promising AHR modulators with potentially therapeutic activities in pathological pathways that lead toneuroinflammation and oxidative stress involved in the pathogenesis of dementia. They offer an avenue for additional experimental validation and encourage further investigation of these leads as sources of new therapeutic modalities to treat neurodegenerativediseases.
abstract_zh: 痴呆症作为一种进行性神经退行性疾病，且疾病修饰治疗选择有限，构成了迅速上升的全球健康挑战。本研究旨在探索来自藏红花（Crocus sativus）和洋甘菊（Matricaria chamomilla）的主要植物化学物质，并应用人工智能片段化技术靶向芳香烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AHR），该受体是痴呆症治疗的专业靶点。从ISO 3632-2-2010 (E)标准规定的藏红花和GC-MS规定的洋甘菊中筛选出生物活性化合物。进行了蛋白质网络映射、密度泛函理论、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，以确定关键植物化学物质（如藏红花醛和红没药醇氧化物A）与AHR的结合亲和力及相互作用稳定性。药代动力学和毒性的计算机模拟ADMET预测显示这些分子具有良好的性质。此外，通过使用人工智能（AI）生成模型优化了其结构和药理特性，以增强药物样特征。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调这些AI增强的植物化学物质作为有前景的AHR调节剂，在导致痴呆症发病机制中涉及的神经炎症和氧化应激的病理通路中具有潜在治疗活性。它们为额外的实验验证提供了途径，并鼓励进一步研究这些先导化合物作为治疗神经退行性疾病新治疗方式的来源。
